disclosures.title: Investment risk disclosure
disclosures.canonical: Investing involves risk, including the possible loss of principal.
variants: All investments involve risk and may lose value, including loss of the principal invested.
You may lose some or all of the money you invest.

disclosures.title: Past performance disclaimer
disclosures.canonical: Past performance does not guarantee future results.
variants: Past performance is not indicative of future results.
Past performance is no guarantee of future returns.

disclosures.title: Not FDIC insured
disclosures.canonical: Not FDIC insured. May lose value. No bank guarantee.
variants: Investment products are not FDIC insured, are not bank guaranteed and may lose value.

disclosures.title: Fees and expenses disclosure
disclosures.canonical: Fees and expenses apply to this account and are described in the fee schedule.
variants: Advisory fees and fund expenses will reduce your returns; see the fee schedule for details.

disclosures.title: Pre-dispute arbitration clause
disclosures.canonical: This agreement contains a pre-dispute arbitration clause.
variants: All parties to this agreement are giving up the right to sue each other in court; disputes are resolved by arbitration.

disclosures.title: Conflicts of interest disclosure
disclosures.canonical: Material conflicts of interest are disclosed in our Form ADV Part 2A brochure.
variants: Our firm has conflicts of interest, which are described in Form ADV.

disclosures.title: Not an offer to buy or sell
disclosures.canonical: This material is not an offer to buy or sell any security.
variants: Nothing in this newsletter constitutes an offer or solicitation to buy or sell securities.
